class: A status, risk-check, result or error line is shown with v-if above or beside buttons or inputs and appears or disappears on an async answer, so the control moves under the user's pointer and the click lands beside it.
mechanism: The line has no reserved height: when it is removed (check finished, no warning) the dialog (centred, content-sized) shrinks and the buttons move; when a result line is added to the pinned status area the buttons move the other way.

first_seen.where: S-26 Stops panel (Lane Q2), then N-22 paper 'Exit Paper positions' dialog (owner C-02 12:11: Cancel moved up about 26 px when 'Checking whether this exit leaves a sold option without protection...' finished; first Cancel click missed)

fix: Put every such line inside an always-rendered slot with a reserved min-height (v-if only on the text inside the slot); the Modal status slot is always passed. jsdom has no layout, so tests pin structure (same slot element before and after, same count of siblings above the actions); the pixels are checked on screen.
